item.title: Map Extras
item.description: Map Extras is a Map mod for Core Keeper available on mod.io. Adds radius circles on the map — mark boss and key locations that spawn at set distances from the world center. What it does Draws radius circles directly on the map Bosses and key structures spawn at fixed distances from world center — circles reveal where to look Radius is adjustable from a text box on the hotbar How to install In the main menu, open Mods → Browse (mod.

item.title: MoreMapReveal
item.description: MoreMapReveal is a Map mod for Core Keeper available on mod.io. Expands the area revealed while exploring — subtle but a big difference when hunting hidden treasure, points of interest and new biomes.
